assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent game UI icon for the Cyberpunk RED cyberware catalogue in dndShare. New original artwork. One isolated complete modular cybernetic forearm with an articulated five-fingered hand, in a clear three-quarter view, wrist slightly bent and fingers relaxed into a strong readable silhouette. Adult human hand proportions; exposed mechanical knuckle joints, three broad ceramic armor plates, a dark wrist connector. Gunmetal and pale cool gray ceramic, restrained teal accent panels and a single amber status light. Practical street cyberware from a 2045 cyberpunk setting, no medieval armor or magic. Polished graphic 2D cel shading matching the project's inventory icons: thick continuous deep-plum outer contour, sparse confident inner lines, broad clean color planes, two-step shading and one broad upper-left highlight, matte materials, almost no surface texture. Entire object centered in a square canvas, occupies 82–86%, comfortable even transparent margin; readable at 64 pixels. Genuine transparent alpha, no background, no checkerboard, no enclosing tile, no disc, no frame, no separate shadow, no floating particles, no glow halo, no scenery, no words, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. No photorealism, no glossy 3D, no micro circuitry.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / expand into a catalogue cover. Image 1 is the identity anchor for the SAME object; preserve construction, proportions, materials, distinctive panels and color placement. Image 2 is STYLE ONLY: variable dark-plum outlines, broad clean cel-painted light and shadow planes, restrained highlights and minimal texture; do NOT copy its people, pose, medieval setting or composition. Make a new independent full scene in Cyberpunk RED's retrofuturist 2045 setting. Mature polished graphic 2D illustration, not a thick-outline enlarged icon, not photorealism or glossy 3D. Main subject clean and readable, background softer with large simplified shapes. No text, words, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, border, badge or painted UI overlays. Opaque artwork. Make a 3:2 landscape illustration. The same pearl-gray, teal-inset cybernetic forearm with gunmetal articulated hand and small amber wrist light lies at a new three-quarter diagonal angle on a low repair cradle in a street ripperdoc clinic. Its complete five-fingered hand and entire arm stay in the central 60% of the frame, occupying about 70% of image height with comfortable margins. A single service cable attaches at the rear wrist connector. Background: subdued metal cabinets, a rounded examination lamp, frosted night window and broad silhouettes of clinic equipment, no readable screens. Cold slate/plum room, warm focused work light makes pale ceramic and skin-free mechanical construction bright and clear. Quiet low-detail lower corners for the site's own title controls. No people, no detached extra limbs, no blood, no gore. Transform the source icon into a more resolved full scene while keeping its recognizable object.
